```yaml
name: Contributor Actions
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  status-checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check for Changes
        id: changes
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v42
        with:
          files: |
            **/*.ts
            **/*.tsx
            **/*.js
            **/*.jsx
            package.json
            package-lock.json

      - name: Get PR Info
        id: pr_info
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "pr_number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "base_ref=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "head_ref=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Validate Status Checks
        if: steps.changes.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Changes detected in files:"
          echo "${{ steps.changes.outputs.changed_files }}"
          
          # Run linting
          npm run lint
          
          # Run tests
          npm test
          
          # Run type checking
          npm run type-check

      - name: Update Status Checks
        if: steps.changes.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Status checks completed successfully"
          echo "Workflow triggered by: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "Changed files count: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.changed_files_count }}"

  change-detection:
    needs: status-checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Detect File Changes
        id: file_changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            docs:
              - '**/*.md'
              - '**/*.mdx'
            config:
              - '.github/**/*'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
            src:
              - 'src/**/*'
              - 'lib/**/*'
            tests:
              - 'test/**/*'
              - 'tests/**/*'

      - name: Analyze Change Impact
        run: |
          echo "Documentation changes: ${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.docs }}"
          echo "Configuration changes: ${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.config }}"
          echo "Source code changes: ${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.src }}"
          echo "Test changes: ${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.tests }}"

      - name: Set Status Based on Changes
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.src }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "BUILD_REQUIRED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
          
          if [ "${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.config }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "CONFIG_CHANGED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
          
          if [ "${{ steps.file_changes.outputs.tests }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "TESTS_REQUIRED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Report Change Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Change Analysis Summary:"
          echo "- Build required: ${{ env.BUILD_REQUIRED }}"
          echo "- Config changed: ${{ env.CONFIG_CHANGED }}"
          echo "- Tests required: ${{ env.TESTS_REQUIRED }}"

  build-and-test:
    needs: change-detection
    if: env.BUILD_REQUIRED == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-artifacts
          path: |
            dist/
            lib/

  notify-status:
    needs: [status-checks, build-and-test]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify Status
        run: |
          if [ "${{ job.status }}" = "success" ]; then
            echo "✅ All checks passed successfully"
          elif [ "${{ job.status }}" = "failure" ]; then
            echo "❌ Some checks failed"
          else
            echo "⚠️ Checks cancelled or skipped"
          fi
```
